## Test section

Here is some test code.

```{r}
x <- 1 + 1
```

This code prints out a result, but doesn't show the code itself. 
You can add options to executable code like this:

```{r}
#| echo: false
x
```

Here is some more complicated code that prints the numbers 1 through 10. 

```{r}
for (i in 1:10) {
  print(i)
}
```
